transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started with the evening operations brief. We'll go in the standard round-robin order—airfield operations, signal, and then medical planning. Each of you, please provide your current qualifications and any readiness updates. Once I've recorded your updates, I'll publish the task-organization order for tomorrow's sustainment schedule. We have three tasks to cover between 0800 and 1200: airfield fuel sampling, radio-cable inspection, and clinic-generator testing. Red, Blue, and Gold teams are all available. Airfield ops, you're up first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have an important readiness update for the tracker. Team Red's fuel-sampling qualification card was renewed and signed by the airfield safety evaluator this morning, so Red is the team qualified for tomorrow's airfield fuel-sampling task. The renewal is still awaiting upload to the shared readiness tracker, so it won't show up there yet, but Red is qualified.
